remarks: Set A's 'second dichroic | reflection target | visible light' claim is bound correctly but its quote ('the visible light is reflected to an off-axis paraboloidal (OAP) mirror') does not itself name the second dichroic. Set A's optical-path claim lists 'entrance to the starshade instrument' as a condition when it is a location. Both sets carry the same figure-label component claims (UV Dichroic, Dichroic, Filters, Grism, OAP, Field stops, Collimated input from FSM), which are low-value but consistent between the sets. The truncated sentence 'This focus is (Figure 5.5-11). The IFS operation can be' is a text-layer/page-split artifact and is correctly ignored by both.
